race.description: Barmah Park Restaurant & Cellar Door Mdn Plate
race.comment: BURNING RUBIES (3) is the main debut threat, a Rubick filly from Andrew Noblet's yard with Thomas Stockdale aboard and enough profile to be treated seriously first time out. Her jumpouts coming in have been sound and all three have been this time in work. Can play a leading role. HOT SAMBA (6) draws barrier 1 for Grahame Begg and Jordan Childs, and that clean starting point gives her a genuine place platform on debut. DIAMOND HEIST (4) has been freshened since a dsebut sicth at Ballarat where she showed enough in defeat. This looks a suitable race on the back of that performance and now Jamie Melham takes over. SPELLBINDING (10) has won both jumpouts in readiness for this and can make an impression right away.
